description: Search fossil occurrences by clade-inclusive base_name or base_id, exact taxon_name, interval or max_ma/min_ma, modern geographic bounds, country, formation, environment, or collection_no. At least one filter is required. Formation matches PBDB stored names and preserves list/wildcard syntax; suffixes are not removed. Resolve uncertain taxon names with paleobiology_get_taxon. Rows carry modern lng/lat, reconstructed paleolng/paleolat, age, strata, classification, and source reference_no; keep the coordinate systems distinct. Every served page row is returned, with total matches and the offset that continues the page. When this deployment has DataCanvas enabled, a first page with additional matches stages up to 50,000 occurrences on a canvas: use paleobiology_dataframe_describe for columns, then paleobiology_dataframe_query for SQL over the staged set; the notice distinguishes complete from partial coverage. Later offsets and complete pages stage nothing and leave any supplied canvas untouched.

base_id.description: Clade-inclusive taxon filter by PBDB taxon id — the accepted_no from paleobiology_get_taxon or an occurrence row. Same clade-inclusive semantics as base_name, but unambiguous where a name is not (homonyms, synonyms, unresolved spellings). Supply this or base_name, never both.

base_name.description: Clade-inclusive taxon filter — this taxon and all descendants, e.g. "Dinosauria". The usual choice. Supply this or base_id, never both.

canvas_id.description: Canvas id from a prior call to restage onto the same workspace. Used only on a first page with matches beyond that page: replaces the prior occurrence table atomically with a bounded matching set, without appending. Later offsets and complete pages leave it untouched. Omit to start fresh.

collection_no.description: Restrict to one collection (locality) by its PBDB collection_no — the fauna found together at that site. Take the id from a paleobiology_search_collections row to drill from a locality into its occurrences.

country.description: PBDB country/continent codes, comma-separated; ! excludes a list and ^ subtracts a code, e.g. NOA,^US.

environment.description: Depositional environment: "marine", "terrestrial", or "freshwater" (lacustrine + fluvial). Omit for all.

formation.description: Stored formation name or PBDB list/wildcard expression, passed unchanged; suffixes such as Formation are not removed.

interval.description: Named geologic interval bounding the age, e.g. "Cretaceous" or "Maastrichtian". Alternative to max_ma/min_ma.

latmax.description: Northern edge of the bounding box, decimal degrees (−90…90). Valid on its own — a lone latitude edge filters as a half-plane.

latmin.description: Southern edge of the bounding box, decimal degrees (−90…90). Valid on its own — a lone latitude edge filters as a half-plane.

limit.description: Maximum occurrences to return per page, up to 10000, subject to PBDB_MAX_OCCURRENCES. Every fetched page row is returned; the notice discloses a lower configured cap. Pair with offset to walk the match set.

lngmax.description: Eastern edge of the bounding box, decimal degrees (−180…180). Longitude is a closed pair — supply lngmin with it or neither.

lngmin.description: Western edge of the bounding box, decimal degrees (−180…180). Longitude is a closed pair — supply lngmax with it or neither.

max_ma.description: Older age bound in millions of years ago. Alternative to interval. When paired with min_ma it must be strictly greater — max_ma is the deeper-time end of the window.

min_ma.description: Younger age bound in millions of years ago. Alternative to interval. When paired with max_ma it must be strictly smaller — min_ma is the nearer-to-present end of the window.

offset.description: Number of matching occurrences to skip before this page — page with limit by advancing offset. The response notice names the exact offset that reaches the next page.

taxon_name.description: Exact taxon filter — only this taxon, not descendants. Use instead of base_name when you want a single taxon.

name: paleobiology_search_occurrences

attribution.description: CC-BY data attribution for the Paleobiology Database.

canvas_id.description: Canvas id holding the staged occurrence set — pass it to paleobiology_dataframe_describe for columns, then paleobiology_dataframe_query for SQL. Present only when spilled is true; complete pages and later offsets stage nothing.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_filter`: The call carried only pagination fields — no taxon, time, place, environment, or collection filter. `conflicting_taxon_filter`: Both base_name and base_id were supplied — PBDB accepts only one clade selector. `incomplete_bbox`: Exactly one of lngmin/lngmax was supplied — a longitude box needs both edges. `inverted_ma_range`: min_ma was greater than or equal to max_ma — the age window is inverted or empty. `pbdb_invalid_parameter`: PBDB refused a filter value it could not use, such as an unknown interval name — the message quotes its reason. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: The first page has additional matches to stage and no canvas_id was passed, but every canvas slot open to this caller is already taken. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Applied filters and empty/past-end guidance, page continuation, ignored upstream filters, staged-set coverage, or optional staging unavailability.

occurrences.description: Every occurrence in the requested page, subject to the configured page cap. When spilled is true, the canvas holds the bounded matching set independently of this page; the notice states whether staging covers every match.

items.description: A single fossil occurrence with modern and paleo coordinates, age, strata, and classification.

accepted_name.description: PBDB accepted name (may differ from the identification under synonymy).

accepted_no.description: PBDB taxon id of the accepted name — chain into paleobiology_get_taxon.

cc.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the modern locality, when known.

classification.description: Higher classification of the accepted name (phylum → genus) — group rows by family or order without a per-row paleobiology_get_taxon call. Each level is present only when PBDB resolves it; omitted entirely when PBDB resolves none.

collection_no.description: Locality this came from — chain into paleobiology_search_collections.

county.description: County of the modern locality, when known.

early_interval.description: Named geologic interval of the older age bound, e.g. "Late Maastrichtian".

geoplate.description: Tectonic plate id under the paleo-model, when reported.

lat.description: MODERN latitude — where the rock sits today. Not where the organism lived.

late_interval.description: Named interval of the younger bound — present only when the age spans two intervals.

lng.description: MODERN longitude — where the rock sits today. Not where the organism lived.

max_ma.description: Older age bound in millions of years ago.

min_ma.description: Younger age bound in millions of years ago.

occurrence_no.description: PBDB occurrence id — read the full record via the paleobiology://occurrence/{occurrence_no} resource.

paleolat.description: PALEO latitude — where the landmass sat at deposition. Omitted when PBDB has no reconstruction.

paleolng.description: PALEO longitude — where the landmass sat at deposition. Omitted when PBDB has no reconstruction.

paleomodel.description: Plate-tectonic model used for the paleo-coordinates (e.g. "gplates"). They are model-dependent.

reference_no.description: PBDB bibliographic reference id — the publication this occurrence was entered from. Resolve it to a full citation with paleobiology_get_references.

state.description: State/province of the modern locality, when known.

row_count.description: Rows staged on the canvas when spilled (at most 50,000); otherwise occurrences returned inline. Compare against totalCount for full-match coverage.

spilled.description: True when the first page had additional matches and the bounded matching set was written to the canvas.

table_name.description: Canvas table holding the staged occurrence set — the FROM target in paleobiology_dataframe_query SQL, and the table paleobiology_dataframe_describe reports columns for. Present only when spilled is true.

totalCount.description: Total occurrences matching the filters upstream — the number this call was drawn from, which may exceed the staged set.

title: paleobiology-mcp-server: search fossil occurrences
